`/desk-update` now runs `/reload-plugins` for you when a new version came in.

- It reloads only after an actual update; when desk-look is already the latest or the update failed, nothing is reloaded
- If the reload can't run, a toast asks you to run `/reload-plugins` yourself
- Updating to this version still runs the previous `/desk-update`, so reload once by hand this time; later updates reload on their own

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
